text: The toy car has a loose wheel. Find a grown-up and a toy repair kit.
You found a grown-up and a repair kit. The grown-up fixes the toy. Ready to roll!
Rain keeps our play inside. Find a storybook and crayons for indoor fun.
A story and some drawing make a fun rainy day!
It is cold outside. Find a warm coat and a hat.
A coat and hat help us feel warm outside.
Water spilled on the table. Find a soft cloth to wipe it up.
Wipe, wipe! The table is dry again.
Toys cover the floor. Find a storage box to make a clear path.
The toys have a place, and our path is clear.
The soil feels dry. Find a watering can and water for the plant.
A little water helps our plant grow.
Our hands are muddy. Find soap and water to wash them.
Rub with soap, rinse with water. Clean hands!
It is raining on our walk. Find an umbrella and rain boots.
An umbrella and rain boots help us enjoy a rainy walk.
Our tummy feels hungry. Find a snack to eat with a grown-up.
We sit with a grown-up and enjoy a snack.
We feel thirsty after playing. Find water and a cup.
Pour some water. A drink helps when we feel thirsty.
Teddy is sleepy. Find a cozy blanket for a rest.
Teddy snuggles under a blanket for a cozy rest.
It is too dark to see our story. Find a lamp to light the page.
Click! The lamp lights our story.
Our paper picture tore. Find a glue stick and paper to patch it.
A paper patch and glue help mend our picture.
The carrots are ready to pick. Find a basket to carry them.
Our carrots fit in the basket. Time to carry them inside.
Our friend wants a rolling game. Find a soft ball we can share.
Roll the soft ball to a friend. Now it is their turn!
Our hair is tangled. Find a hairbrush and a grown-up to help gently.
A grown-up helps brush gently. We can ask for a pause.
Our hands are clean but wet. Find a towel to dry them.
Pat, pat! The towel helps dry our hands.
The toy car cannot cross a gap. Find a toy ramp to make a bridge.
The ramp bridges the gap. Our toy car can cross!

That is useful for another job. Listen to our problem and try another tool.
That can help! Find the other tool we need.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
